name: kaspa-x402
description: Specification and reference implementation for x402 payments on Kaspa.

scripts.check:browser-demo: npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/core run build && npm run site:build && node scripts/check-browser-demo.mjs
scripts.validate:release: npm run build && npm test && npm run validate:schemas && npm run site:deploy:check && npm run check:browser-demo && npm run check:pnn-browser && npm run check:covenant-fixtures && npm run validate:tx-v1-consensus && npm run proof:offline && npm run proof:live:check -- --write-report && npm pack --workspaces --dry-run --json >/tmp/kaspa-x402-pack.json && git diff --check
scripts.validate:release:live: npm run validate:release && npm run proof:live:check -- --live --write-report
